query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!"
        FROM messages m
        WHERE m.group_id = $1
          AND m.created_by <> $2
          AND m.created_at > COALESCE(
              (SELECT r.last_read_at FROM message_read_state r
               WHERE r.group_id = $1 AND r.user_id = $2),
              '-infinity'::timestamptz
          )
